findings.title: RATE_LIMIT_CLEANUP_LOCK_KEY derivation comment is inaccurate
findings.description: The comment claims the key is 'Derived from the ASCII bytes of rate-limit-cleanup' (18 chars), but the actual hex value 0x726174656c696d63 spells 'ratelimc' (8 bytes), which is not a correct packing of 'rate-limit-cleanup'. First 8 bytes of 'rate-limit-cleanup' would be 0x726174652d6c696d ('rate-lim'). The value is functionally correct (unique, non-colliding — verified by test) but the derivation narrative is wrong. Matches pre-existing pattern in AUDIT_RETENTION_LOCK_KEY comment.
